view: 960x540 battle540 arena (res540); the bottom bar starts at y 400.
slot_index: 0 = top, 1 = middle (stepped 80 px toward the enemy), 2 = bottom
anchoring: Fixed feet-anchored slots for every fighter regardless of size: 128x128 canvas top-left = (x-64, y-123) (soles on row 123; flyers keep their baked hover). No size-adapted offsets.

beasts.rule: beast slots are NOT a mirror: the beast columns sit 216 px apart, the party columns 148 px

draw_order: Shadows + slot marks first. Sprites in plain ascending feet y (ties: ascending x), so the middle fighter is drawn BEHIND the bottom fighter. Arena foreground. Then a UI layer above all sprites: plates, intent bubbles, active arrow.
plate_rule: Party 56x24, beasts 56x20, centred directly under each fighter's feet: (x-28, y+10). The bottom line's plates end at y 400, on the bottom bar's top edge.
intent_rule: 22x26 bubble (40x26 with a multiplier) above the beast's head: (visible bbox centre x - 10, visible top - 28), UI layer.
